note: [L] proves the local-integral-plus-two-volume-terms bound in Rain.Zeal.abides (via Boulevard.fountain), stated on flag-free charts. The radial-contraction passage to the closed domain is Boulevard.rising with sunnySoon. The difference: eps_tr is instantiated as the gold term rather than chosen freely.

snippet.text:
lemma abides : ∀ᶠ n:ℕ in atTop,∀ (i:Stars) b W', ‖W'‖+2*furl G L x₀<eaves G L x₀→ flags (B).threshold (Boulevard.actual W')=∅ → ∀ l:List (Directions G (moor C A m i)),l.length ≤ (B).order→ (∀ v∈l,‖v‖ ≤(B).threshold)→ ‖leftDerivs (Boulevard.stillA (Trio.froth (T.offers n b i))) l (Boulevard.actual W')‖ ≤ ticket (B).order (gold G L x₀)+2*((Fintype.card (Site (moor C A m i)):ℝ)*(turnFee B*(gold G L x₀+gold G L x₀)+gold G L x₀)) := by
  apply eventually_all.mpr; intro i
  let H:=panes C A m i; let F:Forest (panel A m H).ratio:= Classical.choice (Tree.select _ (panel A m H).patch.odd_side)
  have hv : Stores.till x₀ ≤ (moor C A m i).val:= by have hp := Trio.highChair k (radiusB x₀) i|>.2; unfold moor Stores.till; omega
  exact Boulevard.fountain R A H (T.tiers i) (T.renewed i) hp.chip hm hT hr hF.1 hd hp.year hR hF.2 hp.plaza hS F hv (T.tinted _ F) -- order

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually in the truncation index, on flag-free charts with ||W'||+2 furl < eaves, the ordered derivatives of the centered reflected local sum are bounded by ticket(gold) + 2|Site|(turnFee(gold+gold)+gold).

lemma rising (j : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ x in atTop,∀ (P: BudgetPoint), P.threshold=Pressure.temp x → P.threshold ≤ 2 * Pressure.fiery G x L → P.order=j →
    ∀ (c:Side) (W:Positions (Uniform.Primary c G)), ‖W‖+2*d' x < p' x →
      flags P.threshold (actual W)=∅ → ∀ (S:ℕ→RegularAddress c) (u:ℕ→ Config G c→ℝ) (H f:Config G c→ℝ)
    (v b z:ℝ), Meadow.Budget P S u b→P.Regular univ H → (∀ V∈ sunny P,f V=z-H V-Boulevard.throng u V) →
      (∀ W': Positions (Uniform.Primary c G),‖W'‖+2*d' x < p' x → actual W'∈ sunny P→ Brush j v (p' x)⁻¹ ((Boulevard.stillA f)∘actual) W') →
    ∀ l:List (Directions G c), l.length ≤ P.order → (∀ i∈l,‖i‖≤P.threshold) → ‖leftDerivs (Boulevard.stillA H) l (actual W)‖ ≤ ticket j v + 2*((Fintype.card (Site c):ℝ)*b):= by

proof_context.conclusion: A derivative bound known on sunny (strictly healthy) charts extends to every flag-free chart, by a limit along radial contractions x*W, x -> 1-.

snippet.text:
lemma sunnySoon (hF: flags P.threshold (actual V)=∅)
    (hp: royalty G*(4*((sunLength J w)*royalty G))^2 < P.threshold *royalty G):
    ∀ᶠ x in (𝓝[<] (1:ℝ)), actual (x • V) ∈ sunny P:= by

proof_context.conclusion: For a flag-free chart V, the radially contracted charts x*V with x -> 1- lie in the sunny (healthy) set.
